name: Artie
description:
Keep warehouse data current without building or operating a CDC stack.
Artie MCP lets you set up and operate continuous replication from a conversation. Tell Claude which database, tables, and destination you need. Artie creates and runs the pipeline that keeps the destination current as production rows change.
Use it when you need fresh operational data in Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, ClickHouse, or another supported destination, without wiring together connectors, replication jobs, backfills, and schema-change handling yourself.
What you can do
- Create a replication pipeline from a source database to a destination
- Select the tables to replicate, then add or remove tables later
- Start, pause, resume, update, or delete pipelines
- Run or cancel backfills
- Detect schema changes and update pipeline configuration
Example prompts
- “Replicate `users`, `orders`, and `payments` from our Postgres primary to Snowflake.”
- “Create a MongoDB to BigQuery pipeline for the `events` collection.”
- “Add the `subscriptions` table to our existing MySQL pipeline.”
- “Pause the staging pipeline while we upgrade the database.”
- “Backfill the last six months of `orders` into Redshift.”
- “Set up an SSH tunnel for this private Postgres instance.”
Supported sources include Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and Oracle. Supported destinations include Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and ClickHouse.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Artie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Artie to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.artie.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Artie MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Artie lists 36 MCP tools, including column_hashing_salt_delete, column_hashing_salt_list, column_hashing_salt_preview, column_hashing_salt_update, connector_delete, connector_drop_postgres_replication_slot, connector_fetch_table_detail, connector_generate_shadow_script, connector_start_dynamo_db_export, data_catalog_search, encryption_key_delete, and encryption_key_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Artie?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Artie in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Artie requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Artie is developed by Artie. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
